component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.global.addFields({ ticket: "" }) m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "WorkerTask") m.task.observeField("report", "onReport")
' (1) Written BEFORE control="run": the task thread does not exist and render->task ' fan-out is off, so only the pre-launch replay can carry these. Guards #1093. m.task.request = "before-1" m.task.request = "before-2"
m.task.control = "run"
' (2) Written AFTER control="run" but still inside init(), so before the render loop's ' first processTasks() pass. Activation already turned fan-out on, but the task has not ' launched yet — the window where both delivery paths used to fire (#1109). m.task.request = "after-1" m.task.request = "after-2"
' (3) Same window, but a field on m.global rather than on the task node: a different ' fan-out route (Node.rendezvousSet), which must still deliver exactly once. m.global.ticket = "global-1" end sub
sub onReport(event as object) print "SCENE REPORT: "; event.getData() m.top.done = true end sub
